hypothesis: Learned beat/downbeat activations can distinguish musical pulses better than the exhausted handcrafted onset selectors; separately measure loss when projecting events to constant S6 grids.

beatnet.license: upstream CC BY 4.0; retain attribution and madmom source notice

beat_this.weights_sha256: bind downloaded bytes in immutable external acquisition manifest before inference
beat_this.causality: offline reference; future context allowed, not a P4 streaming candidate

data.selection: Before annotation values or inference: verify archive/index; exclude known corrupt jazz.00054; collapse identical source-audio MD5s to lexicographically first ID; per genre order remaining IDs by SHA256('libapta-neural-reference-20261022:' + ID), take ten; no replacement after reading annotations or predictions.
data.canonical_audio: reuse tools/apta_1_1_prepare_corpus.py; 48000 Hz stereo PCM16, complete original excerpt, analysis limited to first thirty seconds
data.comparison_input: both neural models receive identical mono source samples resampled from canonical PCM with soxr HQ to 22050 Hz
data.labels: official Beat This annotations v1.0 GTZAN beat/downbeat coordinates, rounded to canonical source frames with half-up rounding
data.dataset_exclusion: both selected checkpoints declare GTZAN excluded from training
data.cross_dataset_identity: dataset exclusion is not proof of composition/recording disjointness; unresolved reuse prevents an independent-transfer promotion claim

metrics.event_metrics: mir_eval beat F-measure and CMLt on beat/downbeat event sequences separately
metrics.aggregation: macro mean of all 100 tracks; no genre or failure exclusion; also report each genre and complete/unresolved reference contexts
metrics.grid_score: unchanged tools/apta_1_1_native_annotated_development.py:score_window, 1% local period and 0.10-beat phase; every source window included
metrics.projection: OLS consecutive predicted beat ordinals within each native S6 window; period converted to nearest millibpm, first in-window anchor rounded half-up; no reference data in candidate projection; unsupported or fewer than four events abstains
metrics.meter: infer only when at least three consecutive predicted downbeats delimit two equal bars of 3 or 4 predicted beat intervals; candidate grid and downbeat must agree within 0.10 beat; otherwise abstain
metrics.confidence: uncalibrated; candidate confidence null, no high-confidence claim; scorer adapter uses 0 only to avoid falsely asserting confidence
metrics.representation_audit: label-derived OLS grid uses the same projection and unchanged scorer on already-open ASAP/Ballroom references; passing is a representability witness, failing is not a proven impossibility ceiling
metrics.baseline: retained unchanged native coarse S6 diagnostic; hash-bound binary and ordinary outputs

resources.physical_p4: not measured; host resources cannot qualify device

gates.preflight: exact source/weights/data/conversion hashes, deterministic PF seed including module-local default_rng, finite valid sorted events, synthetic timestamp/state/parity checks before real model scoring
gates.no_regression: zero confirmed period/phase/joint breaks versus coarse for an eventual native promotion; report all breaks without hiding low confidence or abstentions
gates.confidence_safety: no calibrated confidence supplied; confidence acceptance remains open
gates.port_requires: event gates, exact reference/parity/resource checks and verified independent development; projection failures are resolved separately before product promotion
